learnings: Tool errors (API failures) should not block an overall verdict if all other files are successfully reviewed and found safe; the tool should render a verdict based on available evidence and note the error separately
Both models correctly identified standard VCS packaging patterns (SKIP checksums, git+https sources) as non-malicious, showing good calibration on common AUR patterns
Duplicate file listings (LICENSE appears twice in both reports) suggest the file enumeration logic may have a bug that should be investigated
